notes:
A softer update screen
See your installed version, the next available version, release notes, and clear Update or Later choices. Already up to date? See the current version and when this device last installed the app, with Check again and Close.

A tidier Home
The extra Instagram Feed card is removed. Reels stays in the bottom navigation. Other screens are unchanged.

Install over Dear Diary without uninstalling or clearing data. Android still confirms every install. Last installed update is Android device time, not the web content's last refresh.
